suggestions.title: Price suggestions
suggestions.intro: Suggestions come from a deterministic engine and always stay within the floor/ceiling limits; the explanation sentence is written by AI. A price you accept is locked in; rejecting changes no prices.
suggestions.generated: {count, plural, one {# suggestion generated.} other {# suggestions generated.}} Prices won't change until you accept them.
suggestions.caption: Suggestion contribution table
suggestions.acceptNote: The accepted price goes live right away and is locked; the engine will not update this night again. To go back, you must enter the old price manually in the calendar.
suggestions.accepted: {room} · {date} price changed from {from} to {to} and locked. To undo, enter {from} again in the calendar.
suggestions.rejected: {room} · {date} suggestion rejected; the price stays at {from}.
suggestions.replaceNote: {count, plural, one {# pending suggestion for this room will be replaced by the new ones.} other {# pending suggestions for this room will be replaced by the new ones.}}
suggestions.replaceConfirmTitle: Replace pending suggestions with new ones?

suggestions.generatingStatus: Preparing suggestions. An explanation is written for each night, so this can take a few seconds; please don't reload the page.
suggestions.noneGenerated: No suggestions were generated because this room has no open availability in the coming nights. <link>Open availability in the calendar</link>, then try again.
suggestions.pendingElsewhere: {count, plural, one {# pending suggestion is} other {# pending suggestions are}} waiting in other rooms; choose a room above to see them.
suggestions.priceChanged: This night's price changed after the suggestion was generated; generate suggestions again to compare with the current price.
suggestions.breakdownToggle: Show how the price was calculated

suggestions.rejectAllDone: {count, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}} rejected for {room}; no prices changed.
